[[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst 6]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst 6]]:''' This weapon sings of virtue, dealing 6d6 Good damage on a successful hit to Evil enemies, and 14d6 Good damage on a critical hit to Evil enemies. This effect makes the weapon good aligned.
Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
